blocks.text: Lyca Gairanod has returned to school to pursue her long-time dream of finishing her education, as her song “Puede Nang Mangarap” gains renewed popularity on TikTok. During the announcement of the nationwide karaoke competition TNT SayaOke, Gairanod shared that she has returned to school after previously stopping her studies. “Nag-start na akong mag-aral uli. So gusto ko makapagtapos. Nag-stop po ako. Now, nag-accelerate ako to senior high,” she said.
